features.title: Restore QR labels and manual delivery status controls
features.user_visible_behavior: Orders show their current status and QR labels; authorized operations staff can select hub, on the way, delivered, or another configured status. Unrelated order edits preserve the current status. Dashboard summaries use the heading Order Statuses, call the existing status 7 tile Hub, and show a suitable Unavailable icon. Compact delivery labels show recipient details, QM order number, per-package QR, and PACKAGE n OF total without driver/pharmacy details. Connected scanners and manual entry accept the QR payload or displayed order number. Pharmacy-created orders start at Ready for pickup; status 7 displays Hub consistently and completed outbound hub scans change to On the way.
verification_steps: Verify Ready for pickup / Hub / On the way labels in badges, tracking controls, status filters, and human-readable API responses; preserve configured labels for other statuses. Verify normal/facility pharmacy creation explicitly sets status 1; completed staff hub handoffs set 7 inbound and 3 outbound after all bags; assigned-driver API pickup scans change Hub to On the way, reject another driver, and preserve Delivered. Keep production records and role permissions unchanged.

Verify shared individual/batch/PDF compact labels show recipient details, QM order number, package numbering, and first-bag refrigerator/signature warnings; omit driver/pharmacy details and preserve legacy one-bag fallback. Decode distinct generated QR codes and verify scanner handling of raw, bag-specific, and QM-prefixed order numbers, success, failure recovery, and abort. Inspect isolated browser/PDF output.

Render the pharmacy and admin dashboard summaries with synthetic data; verify Order Statuses, Hub, the Unavailable icon, and preserved counts/filter destinations with the installed styles and icon font.
Verify status badge contrast with missing, blank, supported, and unsupported color values; display Unknown status for blank labels without changing stored status data.

Verify scanner dialog has a visible input, manual submit, error feedback, and Close/Escape support without animation or repeated focus capture; confirm an existing order code opens its preview and dismisses the scanner.
Verify rendered QR labels for multiple bags and missing legacy bag counts.
Verify manual status changes, invalid inputs, role and pharmacy restrictions, delivery completion and reopening.
Verify omitted status and bag fields do not erase existing values.
Run installed tests and smoke checks, asset build, and available PHP formatter.

features.title: Replace (dev) placeholder names for delivery methods, order statuses, and copay statuses
features.user_visible_behavior: Order forms, lists, filters, details, and the app API show real names instead of 'Delivery method N (dev)', 'Status N (dev)', and 'Copay status N (dev)'. Delivery methods: Hand to patient, Signature required, Leave at door, Leave with front desk. Statuses: Ready for pickup, In process, On the way, Delivered, Cancelled, Picked up, Hub, Patient unavailable, Refused, Returned to pharmacy. Copay: No copay, Copay due, Paid by card, Paid in cash, Not paid, Paid at pharmacy. IDs and order rows are unchanged.
